title: 1956 AHSME Problem 5
statement: A nickel is placed on a table. The number of nickels which can be placed around it, each tangent to it and to two others is:

solutions.text:
The centers of the middle nickel and any two neighboring nickels are pairwise two radii apart, so they form an equilateral triangle. Therefore consecutive outer centers subtend \(60^\circ\) at the center of the middle nickel. Exactly \[ \frac{360^\circ}{60^\circ}=6 \] nickels fit around it.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Join the center of the middle nickel to the centers of two neighboring nickels
Those three mutually tangent equal circles make an equilateral triangle of centers
